no_reanalysis_required: Change linear combination coefficients of already analysed compatible basis cases.

reanalysis_required: Change material_id or elastic material properties.

Change physical load magnitudes, receivers or tributary areas.
modification_policy.warning: Changing a result-combination coefficient is not the same as changing the physical load model.

approximations: Slab thickness is the documented 0.15 m HISTORICAL_FALLBACK.
Tributary boundaries use a 0.50 m nearest-beam grid approximation to equal-distance/45-degree transfer.
Unresolved point and line loads are excluded explicitly and are not interpreted as zero.
